items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) DNP all week, listed questionable; coach Coen says game-time decision for TNF vs Ravens.
items.why: Ankle/foot from Week 8; three DNPs despite feeling better comments; Coen GTD call.
items.implication: If OUT/INACTIVE, Chris Rodriguez bulk carries; Tuten still lead if active but snap risk.
items.opportunity: Rodriguez handcuff/waiver priority if Tuten sits; Tuten fade if limited.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson needs thumb surgery and will be placed on injured reserve; out indefinitely, eligible earliest Week 14 after bye.
items.why: Thumb injury requiring surgery sustained Week 8 vs Bills; Schefter report corroborated by Rapoport and ETR flags.
items.implication: Ravens QB chaos; Henry/Zay Flowers usage may shift under backup; long-term ROS downgrade for Jackson.
items.opportunity: Increased work for Derrick Henry and pass-catchers under new QB; monitor Brissett arrival.

items.text: Tests revealed Ravens QB Tyler Huntley suffered season-ending turf toe; Joe Fagnano will start Thursday vs Jaguars.
items.why: Turf toe from Week 8; Schefter/Rapoport reports; surgery expected.
items.implication: Full Ravens QB depth collapse; Fagnano emergency start TNF; trade for Brissett incoming.
items.opportunity: Ravens skill players (Henry, Flowers, Andrews) face short-term volatility then potential Brissett upgrade Week 10+.

items.text: Cardinals placing rookie RB Jeremiyah Love on IR with high-ankle sprain; out 4-5 weeks, eligible Week 13.
items.why: New high-ankle sprain Week 8 vs DAL (unrelated to prior ankle issues); Rapoport break, team confirmed.
items.implication: Love ROS crushed; Allgeier expected lead role, Bam Knight (concussion) secondary.
items.opportunity: Tyler Allgeier volume spike; monitor Bam Knight clearance for committee.

items.text: 49ers RB Christian McCaffrey (mild hamstring) DNP Wednesday; says feels great and has chance to practice/play Week 9 vs Raiders; Mike Evans also DNP.
items.why: Mild hamstring from Week 7; routine Wed rest post-bye; Shanahan optimistic, CMC self-reports good.
items.implication: Likely plays but monitor Thu/Fri; if limited/out, handcuff elevates vs soft LV run D.
items.opportunity: CMC still RB1 if active; Evans rib concern secondary for SF pass game.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens (expected complete weekend); Fagnano starts TNF, Brissett likely Week 10+.
items.why: Ravens QB emergency post Jackson/Huntley; Schefter/Rapoport; Brissett demoted in ARI after Minshew surge.
items.implication: Stabilizes Ravens offense ROS; potential boost for Henry/Flowers/Andrews under veteran QB vs Fagnano.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass-catchers and Henry safer floors Week 10+; ARI QB situation settled with Minshew.

items.text: Jets WR Garrett Wilson entered concussion protocol (day-to-day) after helmet hit late Week 8; Week 9 vs KC status in doubt.
items.why: Helmet-to-helmet Week 8 vs LV; symptoms reported Monday; Glenn day-to-day.
items.implication: If OUT, Adonai Mitchell/Omar Cooper elevated targets; Wilson WR2 risk.
items.opportunity: Jets WR2/3 upside if Wilson inactive; monitor clearance Friday/Saturday.

items.text: ETR Week 9 flags: Lamar IR-likely, AJ Brown out another game, Jonathan Taylor saga continues; SEA RB committee context; LV Washington/Jeanty waiver.
items.why: Levitan/Silva team-by-team pod and injury posts; multi-player status/role emphasis.
items.implication: Priority monitoring for Ravens/Pats/Colts/Raiders backfields and WRs.
items.opportunity: Washington over Jeanty short-term; Taylor uncertainty creates IND RB handcuff value.

items.text: ETR waiver analysis: Mike Washington handed LV workhorse role Week 8 (25-2 carry edge over Jeanty); stickiness TBD but workload noteworthy; Jeanty receiving still strong.
items.why: Daigle/Levitan opportunity focus on snaps/carries; Kubiak comments support committee but Washington lead.
items.implication: Washington high FAAB; Jeanty still rosterable for pass work.
items.opportunity: Washington RB2/flex if role holds; Jeanty PPR floor via targets.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty saw just 2 carries Week 8 while Mike Washington got 25; coach Kubiak says week-to-week split, Jeanty still pass-game role.
items.why: Washington 25-2 carry edge Week 8; Kubiak 'moving target' comments; ETR waiver flags Washington/Jeanty.
items.implication: Jeanty RB2/flex risk with receiving floor; Washington waiver/handcuff priority.
items.opportunity: Washington workhorse potential sticky; Jeanty third-down/receiving value remains elite.

items.text: Seahawks rule out QB Sam Darnold (quad); Drew Lock set to start Sunday vs Cardinals.
items.implication: SEA pass game downgrade; JSN/K9 still viable but Lock ceiling lower.
items.opportunity: Jaxon Smith-Njigba volume may hold; Lock streamer only in 2QB.

items.text: Browns place QB Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol; Shedeur Sanders in line to start Sunday.
items.implication: CLE QB change; Judkins/Njoku etc. face rookie QB variance.
items.opportunity: Monitor Sanders start; CLE skill players riskier.

items.text: Berry Happy Hour reacts to Jeremiyah Love IR; tough Week 9 sit/start decisions and mailbag; Love placement shifts ARI backfield outlook.
items.why: Podcast covers Love IR news and keep-open/close decisions for tough starts.
items.implication: Per-player Love/Hate style; ARI RBs elevated in rankings discussions.
items.opportunity: Allgeier start consideration; Love stash only in deep/IR leagues.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) DNP Wednesday after missing Week 8; status cloudy for Week 9 vs GB, Vrabel non-committal on IR.
items.why: Recurring knee flare + ankle; ETR flagged AJB out; multiple DNPs.
items.implication: High miss risk Week 9; Maye targets to Douglas/Hollins (IR return candidate) if out.
items.opportunity: NE WR depth upside; Brown fade until full practices.
